recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for FHIR-20478. If the CodeSystem Boundaries and Relationships text should be harmonized, handle it through FHIR-54129 or another final work-group decision rather than expanding this published NamingSystem issue.
issue_request: FHIR-20478 was a Published Vocab change request for R5 asking to clarify the specific use of NamingSystem. The persuasive-with-modification resolution replaced the NamingSystem Boundaries and Relationships prose so NamingSystem is described as managing identifiers of code or identifier systems, identifier metadata, and limited system metadata, while CodeSystem can represent code-system content and other metadata.
initial_application: The issue was applied by git commit 9500b398d1d850a06cd180c82ce330e4809a2b49, "vocab r5 tickets batch 2", which replaced source/namingsystem/namingsystem-introduction.xml with the approved replacement. The current source/fhir.ini has namingsystem as an active resource, and the current NamingSystem introduction still contains that replacement.
additional_context: Zulip and Confluence evidence show the work group was clarifying the CodeSystem/NamingSystem boundary and NamingSystem's identifier-metadata role. The CodeSystem introduction still has older relationship prose, but that later CodeSystem-page concern is now directly covered by FHIR-54129, an R6 technical-correction issue in Resolved - change required / indeterminate status that was reopened with concerns, so it was not decided in this default Applied/Published seed run.
reconciliation: No source was changed. An empty audit commit was published because FHIR-20478 is already reflected in the active NamingSystem source, and changing the parallel CodeSystem page here would preempt a later unresolved work-group decision.

related_jiras.note: R6 CodeSystem Text Technical Corrections specifically proposes changing the parallel CodeSystem Boundaries and Relationships prose, but it is not Applied/Published and was reopened with concerns.
